data.name: Woolberry Ranch
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Woolberry Ranch – a cozy, colorful life sim where you build your dream farm, befriend affectionate animals, and grow a world full of charm, one berry at a time.

Whether you're planting sun-kissed vegetables, selling handmade goods at your roadside stand, or simply spending the day brushing your favorite llama, every moment at Woolberry Ranch is a chance to slow down, create, and connect.

Join our Discord community! 

                                                              

Wholesome Farming – Place garden plots wherever you like and shape your land your way. Plant seeds, water your crops, and harvest fresh produce.

Affection-Based Animals – Llamas, chickens, and other animals react to your care and attention. The more love you show, the more they trust and reward you.

In-Game Photography – Snap cozy memories with your in-game camera. Save them to your photo album, frame your favorites, and decorate your home with personal moments.

Roadside Selling – Customize your prices, stock your stand, and watch customers roll in. Track your sales with your real time sales data and grow your own small-town economy.

Gentle Fishing – Cast your line with charm-based lures and collect fish with unique personalities. Keep them as pets in decorative fishbowls or aquariums.

Customizable World – It's your ranch, your way. Place items freely, decorate your land, and make it truly feel like home.

No pressure. No combat. Just you, your ranch, and a world that grows with love.

data.short_description: After leaving everything behind, you and your four-legged friend arrive at a wild patch of land ready for rebirth. Grow crops, raise animals, and make friends while running a produce stand to help keep the native villagers happy and healthy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD CPU, 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
